freeze_gates.mass: component-level preliminary roll-up, nominal dry + 10 % + selected Xe load < 40 kg wet (preferably <= 39.4 kg)
freeze_gates.power: 12 mN AIR and a 25 mN capability mode (Xe, compressor OFF) < 1500 W with real margin (~<= 1450 W); exactly 1500 W is not compliant
freeze_gates.operating_concept: AIR density window + altitude scheduling + Xe contingency formally mapped to RFP / RVM
freeze_gates.host_interface: reference C_D*A and host-drag ICD requirement frozen

owner_decision_summary.requirement_interpretation: Nominal AIR operation uses density-aware altitude scheduling within 180-230 km; Xe is the required secondary / contingency mode where AIR cannot meet the necessary thrust / drag margin. The 196 states remain a conservative verification / design set, not 196 mandatory independent AIR operating points; states outside the AIR window invoke the RFP-required Xe capability (the short-term-high exception is recorded, not hidden).
owner_decision_summary.IR_HOST_DRAG_01: Host-spacecraft aerodynamic C_D*A shall be provided at PDR and shall remain within the propulsion-system drag-compensation envelope; reference proposal sizing uses C_D*A = 0.50 m2
owner_decision_summary.aperture: retain 0.70 m2 physical aperture; 26.8 km/s air-Hall design / reference basis, 22 km/s sensitivity / risk case; EM verification after award; altitude / Xe contingency when the AIR thrust / drag margin is insufficient
owner_decision_summary.not_required_before_freeze: full Hall simulation, DSMC, compressor-map testing, ICP bench testing, AO life testing
owner_decision_summary.freeze_wording: DBF-1.2 — RFP-COMPLIANT PRELIMINARY DESIGN BASELINE / EM VERIFICATION OPEN (complies by specification and allocation, not by demonstration)

recorder_notes: The earlier internal RVM reading (every one of the 196 states as an independent AIR hard-requirement point) is superseded for the active baseline by this explicit requirement-interpretation decision; it is not silently discarded and stays in the historical RVM records.
